newsitem.title: CANADA: Reuters opens bureau in Quebec City.
newsitem.headline: Reuters opens bureau in Quebec City.

text.p: Reuters America Inc said on Wednesday it opened a news bureau in Quebec City, the capital of Canada's French-speaking province of Quebec.
Reuters said its editorial presence in the city would enable it to expand its Canadian coverage, monitor the Quebec political scene and provide additional news reports in French.
"The opening of the Quebec City bureau reflects Reuters commitment to increasing the breadth and depth of our news coverage from Canada,'' Stephen Jukes, Editor, Reuters America, said in a statement.

"It also reflects a recognition of Canada's political realities and our determination to provide news with a balanced perspective from mainly French-speaking Quebec," said Jukes. "Reuters is the first international news agency to establish a full-time news presence in Quebec's legislative capital."

The Reuters bureau, staffed by correspondent Patrick White and a part-time photographer and researcher, will file stories in French and English for its international news services and support Reuters Online Canada, a multimedia service that delivers online news, features and photo packages to Canadian Web publishers, corporate sites and corporate intranets.
Reuters newest reporting bureau in Quebec City brings the number of Reuters Canadian editorial bureaus to seven and the number of bureaus in North America to 29.
Reuters established a full-time editorial presence in Canada in the early 1970s. Reuters other Canadian bureaus are Toronto, Montreal, Ottawa, Vancouver, Calgary and Winnipeg.

Reuters America Inc is the primary operating division in the Americas of Reuters Holdings Plc. Reuters supplies the global business community and news media with real-time financial data, transaction systems, information management systems, access to numerical and textual historical databases, news, graphics, photos and news video.
